question: What is the purpose of the Slide Master in MS PowerPoint?

options.text: To apply consistent formatting, fonts, and layouts to all slides
To delete multiple slides at once

solution:
The correct answer is __**To apply consistent formatting, fonts, and layouts to all slides**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Slide Master is a feature in MS PowerPoint used to ensure **uniform design and formatting** across all slides in a presentation.
 
• It allows users to customize elements like **fonts, colors, backgrounds, and placeholders**, which are then applied globally to all slides.
 
• The Slide Master streamlines the process of maintaining **consistency in layouts** for titles, content, and other elements.
 
• Users can also create **custom slide layouts** within the Slide Master to suit specific design needs.
 
• Any changes made in the Slide Master affect **all slides linked to that master**, saving time and effort in editing individual slides.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Slide Master Terminology:**

 
 
• **Master Slide:** The main slide that controls the design and layout for all associated slides.
 
• **Layouts:** Specific slide designs controlled by the master slide, including placeholders for text and images.
 
 
 
• **Consistency in Design:**
 
 
• Ensures presentations look professional and cohesive, especially in business or academic settings.
 
 
 
• **Time Efficiency:**
 
 
• Reduces the need to format individual slides, as changes in the Slide Master are applied universally.
 
 
 
• **Advanced Customization:**
 
 
• Users can add logos, watermarks, or other branding elements to all slides using the Slide Master.
 
 
 
• **Accessing Slide Master:**
 
 
• Located under the **View** tab in the MS PowerPoint ribbon.
